title: Two Sum in Sorted Array
statement: Given sorted distinct integers and target t, print 1-based indices i j (i < j) with values summing to t, or -1 -1 if none.

io_format.input_description: Line 1: n. Line 2: sorted ints. Line 3: t.

editorial: Shrink range based on sum vs target.

reference_solutions.python:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
n = int(data[0])
arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
t = int(data[1+n])
l, r = 0, n-1
while l < r:
    s = arr[l]+arr[r]
    if s == t:
        print(l+1, r+1)
        exit()
    if s < t:
        l += 1
    else:
        r -= 1
print(-1, -1)
